[[File:Heavy_weapon_specialist.jpg|thumb|A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] heavy weapon specialist]]
A '''heavy weapon specialist''' was a position, that existed in the [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] of various armies for thousands of years. Due to their training and expertise, several soldiers handled [[heavy weapon]]ry with notable proficiency and as such, were assigned to the positions where such skills could be put to greater use. In the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commander]] [[Jet/Legends|Jet]] served as a heavy-weapons specialist, trained in the use of gear such as [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] and [[Fire/Legends|fire]]-resistant [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWE Jet">{{SWE|characters|clone-commander-jet|Clone Commander Jet}}</ref>
